label: Required documents present
why: A dispute without its required documents is denied.
fix: Attach the missing document.

label: PO number matches
why: Every document must point to the PO being disputed.
fix: Get a corrected copy showing the right PO number.

label: Ship-to matches
why: The delivery address must match the PO's ship-to location.
fix: Confirm the delivery location with the carrier and get a corrected copy.

label: Stamp or signature present
why: Walmart treats a POD without a DC stamp or store signature (or a BOL without a carrier signature) as invalid for shortages.
fix: Request the stamped or signed copy from the carrier using the PRO number.

label: Amounts reconcile exactly
why: A dispute amount that doesn't match its backup is rejected even when the claim is valid.
fix: Set the dispute amount to the documented shortage, to the cent.

label: Proof type fits prepaid or collect
why: Prepaid shipments need a POD; collect shipments need a carrier-signed BOL.
fix: Attach the proof type that matches the shipment terms.

label: Deduction settled
why: Disputing before a deduction settles can produce approvals that are later reversed.
fix: Wait until the deduction shows as posted, then submit.

label: Prior denial addressed
why: A re-dispute must fix what the last denial said was wrong.
fix: Add the evidence the previous denial asked for.
